text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the big day. Nishino Flower will finally debut in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …I'm sure things will go fine.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I trained really, really hard. So I'll be okay… Right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you… Let's head to the racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Did you see all the racers debuting today? There's this one named Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, they're talking about me.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: She enrolled at the academy early, yeah? It's impressive, sure, but she's still just a kid. I wonder if she's up to this?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: C'mon, this is Tracen Academy we're talking about. They're sure to have a great support system in place.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: But her trainer seems pretty inexperienced. I really hope she's been receiving proper guidance.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Oh, right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower has been really quiet for a while now. Hearing people talk about her might have shaken her confidence. Even so…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You've been saying the same thing all day.
choice_data_list: Sorry I'm not a better motivator…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah! I didn't mean it like that! I'm really happy you're cheering me on like this!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, I can do this. I trust you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: But her trainer seems pretty inexperienced. I really hope she's been receiving proper guidance.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Trainer might be new and inexperienced, but they've done everything in their power to guide me here.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (If I give it my all today… If I can really do this…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Then maybe everyone watching will see Trainer in a new light.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …All right. Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's time to show them all that I have the hardest-working trainer on the planet!
